prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1370; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording. You can call me the claimant.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was on a two-lane road in Sugar Land, Texas, near a shopping center. Traffic was light and it was raining a little.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I was driving home from work, heading east. The other car came over into my lane.

Q: How fast were you traveling?

A: Maybe twenty-five miles an hour. I had just started to slow down for the curve.

Q: Was there a head-on impact?

A: Yes, the front of his car hit the front of mine, but it wasn't a hard hit. Both airbags stayed in, I think. The car just stopped.

Q: Did you feel any pain or injury at the scene?

A: My wrist hurt right away. I tried to brace myself on the steering wheel, and it felt wrong. I didn't think it was broken at first.

Q: Did you seek medical treatment?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They took X-rays and told me I have a fracture in my wrist. I'm in a cast now and I have a follow-up with a hand specialist next week.

Q: Are you currently having any trouble working or with daily activities?

A: I can't drive much right now, and I can't write or cook easily with my right hand. My job involves typing, so I've been out for a while.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and I didn't do anything to cause this. Thank you.
